about.title: Your local pest control experts.
text: At Eco-Pest Inc. we understand that pests do not just threaten your property, they threaten your peace of mind. That is why we have dedicated ourselves to providing Houston and the surrounding areas with effective, environmentally responsible pest control.

Our team of ACE-certified technicians brings years of experience and ongoing training to every job. We use the latest eco-friendly technologies and methods to protect your home while keeping the environmental impact down.
We are a local, family-owned company serving the Houston community, a licensed pest control company and a Sentricon Authorized Operator.

values.text: Serving the Houston community with pride and dedication.

faqs.q: How quickly will you get back to me?
faqs.a: Within 30 minutes during business hours. Same-day emergency service is available when the problem cannot wait.

faqs.q: Do I have to sign a contract?
faqs.a: No. There are no contracts and no cancelation fees, including on the quarterly protection plan.

faqs.q: Is the treatment safe around children and pets?
faqs.a: Yes. We use eco-friendly products and pet and child safe treatments on every job.
No. Inspections are free and comprehensive, and you get the quote after we have seen the property.

faqs.q: What if the pests come back?
faqs.a: Give us a call. If for any reason you are not satisfied with the results of an Eco-Pest application, we will come back until you are satisfied or refund the charge for the application. Quarterly plans include unlimited callbacks between visits.

faqs.q: Do you treat businesses as well as homes?
faqs.a: Yes, commercial and residential. Quarterly protection plans are available for both.

facts.heading: 100% satisfaction guarantee
facts.text: If for any reason you are not satisfied with the results of an Eco-Pest application, give us a call. We will continue to come back until you are satisfied, or we will refund the charge for the application.

facts.heading: Referral program
facts.text: Refer a friend and get 50% off your next service. Your friend gets 10% off their first treatment too.

facts.heading: How It Works: Paying Online
facts.text: Submit a payment request with your invoice number and amount. The team verifies the invoice and contacts you to complete payment securely by phone or a secure link, and a confirmation and receipt follow by email. Card details are never stored on our servers. You can also pay by phone at (281) 488-3362.

facts.heading: Service request
facts.text: The free quote form takes your name, phone, email, the service you need (general pest control, termite treatment, rodent control, mosquito control, bed bug treatment, wildlife removal or other / not sure), your property address and a note about the problem. We get back to you within 30 minutes during business hours.

facts.heading: Not sure if we serve your area?
facts.text: We serve the Greater Houston area and are always expanding. If you do not see your city listed, give us a call and we may still be able to help.

reviews.author: Sarah M., Sugarland
reviews.text: Eco-Pest has been servicing our home for over 3 years now. They're always professional, on time, and the treatments are very effective. Haven't seen a roach since they started!

reviews.author: James P., Pearland
reviews.text: Had a serious termite problem and was worried about my home. The team came out same day, did a thorough inspection, and explained everything clearly. The Sentricon system they installed works great!

reviews.author: Linda T., Missouri City
reviews.text: I called about a mouse problem and they came out the next morning. Problem solved within a week! They also sealed up entry points to prevent future issues.

reviews.author: Maria G., Cypress
reviews.text: What I love most is that they use eco-friendly products. I have pets and young kids, so it was important to me. The technician Chase was super professional and answered all my questions.

reviews.author: Robert K., Katy
reviews.text: Best pest control company in Houston! Their quarterly service keeps our restaurant pest-free. Very reasonable prices and excellent customer service.

reviews.author: David W., Houston
reviews.text: The referral program is awesome - got half off my treatment when my neighbor signed up! Great service and great value. Highly recommend Eco-Pest Inc.
